## Summary of Changes
Provide a brief summary of the changes made and the motivation behind them.

Closes # (issue number if applicable)

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature causing existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Refactoring / Architecture improvement
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Security fix / Hardening

## Verification & Testing
Describe the tests you ran to verify your changes. Include steps so others can reproduce.

- [ ] Unit tests added/updated (`npm run test:unit`)
- [ ] Integration tests added/updated (`npm run test:integration`)
- [ ] Type check passes cleanly (`npm run typecheck`)
- [ ] Code formatting and linter checks pass (`npm run lint`)

## Architectural Checklist
- [ ] No simulated bypasses or security downgrades introduced
- [ ] Rego policies updated and tested if authorization logic changed
- [ ] DPoP and cryptographic proof verifications preserved
- [ ] All code comments, error messages, and documentation in international English
